items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: I played with some of the best bands in different combinations. Tommy Dossie, Mount, Mount City Blue Blows, Tommy Dossie, all those guys, Coleman Hawkins.

ctx.x: I remember those records you made with, um, Red Allen.

Yeah, oh, Billy Banks, all the Dixieland group. I made a lot of recordings with them, and I played with some of the best bands in different combinations. Tommy Dossie, Mount, Mount City Blue Blows, Tommy Dossie, all those guys, Coleman Hawkins.
I'm trying to think, did you belong to any big band during the 30s? Yes, Cab Calloway.
